			<title>Technical Program Manager</title> 
			<link>https://app.gurulink.ca/jobview.asp?JobID=7936</link> 	 
			<description><img src="https://app.gurulink.ca/img/gl_logo_112x112.jpg" border="0"><br><br><b>Location:</b> REMOTE / Nashville, Tennessee - USA<br><b>Job Type:</b> Permanent<br><br><b>Description:</b><p>Our client is a venture-backed digital health company changing how people with joint, back, and muscle (musculoskeletal) conditions find and move through specialty care. Rather than leaving patients to sort out their options alone, the company combines a detailed understanding of each person's symptoms, history, and goals with predictive models and current clinical evidence, then steers them toward the treatment most likely to help and stays with them along the way.<br><br>The company is remote-first with an optional hub in Nashville, and is in a phase of rapid growth and expansion into new markets. The team is collaborative, curious, and driven by the mission of getting people out of pain.<br><br><h4>This Role:</h4>The Technical Program Manager will drive the company's most complex, multi-team technical initiatives inside the Product organization. You will be the person who turns a product idea into a coordinated plan that engineering, data, product, and operations can all execute against, and you will stay with it from kickoff through launch and into the review of how it actually performed.<br><br>You will need enough technical fluency to understand how the platform fits together, including the application software, the data platform, and the data science and modelling work that feeds clinical decisions, so you can spot dependencies early and keep teams from blocking one another. This is a high-visibility role in a growing organization with real room to shape how programs are run.<br><br><h4>You Will:</h4>• Own large, cross-team technical programs from the initial plan through rollout and the post-launch review of results<br>• Act as the go-to owner for each program, keeping product, engineering, data, and operations leaders aligned on scope, timing, and status<br>• Partner with Operations to coordinate release planning and backlog refinement so launches land cleanly with the teams who use the product<br>• Surface risks and dependencies early and put practical mitigation plans in place<br>• Map how systems connect across software, data infrastructure, and data science so sequencing decisions are grounded in the real architecture<br>• Use delivery data and metrics to guide decisions, report progress, and flag trouble before it becomes a delay<br>• Raise the bar on how programs are run: refine planning, tracking, and reporting practices as the organization scales<br>• Travel occasionally (up to roughly 10%) for team planning sessions and company events</p><br><b>Must Have skills:</b><p>• 7+ years of program management leading complex, cross-functional technical initiatives<br>• 3+ years in healthcare technology or digital health<br>• Track record of bringing new products to market alongside product and engineering teams<br>• Solid grounding in program management best practices and Agile delivery<br>• Advanced, day-to-day use of Jira for planning, tracking, and reporting<br>• Comfortable using data and analytics to drive decisions and expose risk<br>• Able to read technical architecture and reason about cross-system dependencies<br>• Excellent written and verbal communication; confident presenting to leadership<br>• Able to travel up to approximately 10%<br>• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience</p><br><b>Nice to have skills:</b><p>• Leading technical programs in another regulated industry (finance, insurance, government, etc.)<br>• Programs that span data platforms, analytics, or machine learning in addition to application software<br>• Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment<br>• Release management experience coordinating launches with operations or clinical teams</p><br><br></description> 
            <category>technical program manager</category><category>program management</category><category>tpm</category><category>agile</category><category>jira</category><category>cross-functional</category><category>release management</category><category>product launch</category><category>risk management</category><category>dependency management</category>

			<title>Sr Software Developer II</title> 
			<link>https://app.gurulink.ca/jobview.asp?JobID=7935</link> 	 
			<description><img src="https://app.gurulink.ca/img/gl_logo_112x112.jpg" border="0"><br><br><b>Location:</b> REMOTE / Toronto, Ontario - Canada<br><b>Job Type:</b> Permanent<br><br><b>Description:</b><p>The client is a healthcare AI company that turns routine lab results into clinically validated chronic disease risk predictions. Their algorithm is CE marked in Europe through a partnership with a global diagnostics company and is being embedded into specialty care workflows through a second strategic partnership. They closed a funding round in the past year and are building out their engineering team.<br><br>THE OPPORTUNITY<br><br>This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Engineering. You own the build of a brand-new population health platform from day one. Nothing exists yet beyond a rough prototype, so you will help choose the stack, design the architecture, and write most of the code.<br><br>The core of the platform is getting clinical data in. Patient data arrives from clinics and partner organizations through EMR integrations (HL7, FHIR) and large bulk uploads of hundreds of thousands of patient records at a time. You will build the ingestion, cleaning and de-duplication so that data lands correctly in the platform, then build what sits on top of it: the APIs, the database, and the user-facing app that surfaces the patients most at risk.<br><br>You will work closely with the company's new product lead to turn clinical and business needs into user stories, technical specs and an MVP targeted for Q1. A QA/DevOps engineer owns the pipelines. As the team grows you will mentor more junior developers through pairing and code review.<br><br>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE<br><br>• A stack and architecture decision you can defend, made in your first month (front end likely React, backend open, with Java/Spring Boot a leading option for FHIR).<br>• Reliable ingestion of large clinical datasets with validation, cleaning and de-duplication built in.<br>• Working EMR integrations over HL7 and FHIR.<br>• An MVP of the population health platform delivered with the product lead in Q1.<br><br>DAY TO DAY<br><br>• About 90% technical: architecture-heavy at the start, then mostly hands-on coding.<br>• Own features end to end: data model, API and UI.<br>• Break user stories into technical specs with the product lead.<br>• Handle health data (PHI) in line with privacy and security requirements.<br>• No direct reports for now. Light, self-managed project management.<br><br>LOCATION AND COMPENSATION<br><br>Toronto preferred, then Winnipeg, then remote anywhere in Canada. $180,000 to $220,000 CAD base plus ESOP participation and benefits.</p><br><b>Must Have skills:</b><p>• 8+ years of professional software development, building and shipping production web applications end to end (front end, back end, database, APIs).<br>• Hands-on EMR integration experience with HL7 and/or FHIR.<br>• Experience ingesting, cleaning and de-duplicating large datasets (hundreds of thousands of records or more).<br>• Has built a product from scratch at a smaller company or startup and made the core architecture and stack decisions.<br>• Strong system design and data modeling judgment, and can explain the trade-offs.<br>• Works directly with product management on requirements and communicates clearly with technical and non-technical people.</p><br><b>Nice to have skills:</b><p>• Shipped software regulated as a medical device (SaMD) under IEC 62304 / ISO 13485 design controls (strongly preferred).<br>• Java and Spring Boot, especially with FHIR libraries (HAPI FHIR or similar).<br>• React.<br>• Azure and modern CI/CD.<br>• Putting ML models into production (versioning, monitoring, retraining).<br>• Multi-tenant or role-based SaaS.<br>• Health data privacy and security (PHIPA, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2).<br>• Mentoring junior developers through pairing and code review.<br>• Uses AI-assisted development tools on production code.</p><br><br></description> 
            <category>Senior Software Developer</category><category>Senior Software Engineer</category><category>Staff Engineer</category><category>Full Stack</category><category>HL7</category><category>HL7 v2</category><category>FHIR</category><category>HAPI FHIR</category><category>EMR</category><category>EHR</category>

			<title>SQA Analyst (US Remote Contract) /  LMS</title> 
			<link>https://app.gurulink.ca/jobview.asp?JobID=7934</link> 	 
			<description><img src="https://app.gurulink.ca/img/gl_logo_112x112.jpg" border="0"><br><br><b>Location:</b> REMOTE / Orlando, Florida - USA<br><b>Job Type:</b> Contract<br><br><b>Description:</b><p>This a corp to corp role.<br><br>The SQA Analyst responsibilities include the following.<br><br><br>Project: Learning Management.<br><br><br><br>Work Description and Responsibilities:<br><br><br>The Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Analyst is responsible for ensuring software quality in Information System’s projects.  The SQA Analyst is responsible for all Quality Assurance (QA) activities throughout the project’s life cycle.  The SQA Analyst works closely with the Project Leadership team to ensure QA activities are planned and executed.  The SQA Analyst must be competent in Publix’s software testing methodologies, procedures, and testing tools.<br>The SQA Analyst responsibilities include the following.<br>Test Planning.  Works directly with project teams to understand testing requirements for the project.  Develops strategies and plans for approval from the Project Lead.  Provides estimates and task lists for the testing activities within projects.<br>Test Analysis.  Reviews project requirements and design specifications to ensure test requirements can be derived from other project deliverables.  Using these deliverables, determines testing requirements that define the testing to be developed and executed for the project.<br>Test Design.  From project requirements and design specifications, designs the test cases, test procedures, and coverage within testing tools.  Makes decisions on appropriate levels of test automation within projects.<br>Test Case Creation.  From the design of the cases and procedures, creates manual or automated test cases and procedures from the test design specifications. <br>Testing.  Conducts testing activities from test plans.  Verifies testing results and accurately tracks defects. <br>Project Metrics.  Performs metrics analysis and develops metric reports for assigned projects.  Presents project metrics information to management on project defects.<br>Education and mentoring.  Pursues education addressing testing methodologies, automated test tools, systems development life cycles and business area/system knowledge.  Actively participates in mentoring associates by coaching them on the testing processes, tools, and applications they will be testing. <br><br><br>Contract Terms:<br><br>- Initial 6-month contract to start (Approx: 1040 standard hours)<br>- Working hours: 8 am - 4:30 pm (EST). The contractor must work the EST time zone. Also must live in EST or CST time zones during the project.<br>- Corp to Corp engagement only. The contractor must work via a corp.<br><br><br>*** IMPORTANT – Please Read Before Applying: ***<br><br>Work Authorization: Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) with unrestricted authorization to work in the United States.<br>Location Requirement: Candidates must be physically located and residing within the United States for the full duration of the project engagement.<br>No Third-Party Representation: Subcontracting, candidate substitution, or re-assignment is strictly prohibited. Applications must be submitted directly by the individual performing the work.<br><br>Identity Verification & Compliance:<br><br>Government ID Required: Valid U.S. government-issued photo identification, and screenshot will be required as part of the screening process.<br>Day-One Verification: Identity verification will be conducted on the FIRST DAY of engagement.<br>Video Participation: All interviews and project-related meetings will be conducted via live video. Candidates must be physically present in the U.S. during all interactions.<br><br>Fraud Prevention Notice (Mandatory Compliance):<br><br>Zero Tolerance Policy: Any form of impersonation, proxy interviewing, AI/deepfake representation, or misrepresentation of identity will result in immediate disqualification and will be reported.<br>Ongoing Verification: Identity validation may be conducted at multiple stages throughout the hiring process and engagement.<br>Device & Access Integrity: Company-issued or approved equipment will be monitored to ensure compliance and prevent unauthorized remote access or third-party involvement.<br><br>Interview Policy:<br><br>No External Assistance: The use of AI tools, external resources, proxy support, or any unauthorized assistance during interviews is strictly prohibited.<br>Monitoring & Enforcement: Interviews will be monitored for compliance. Any suspected violation will result in immediate removal from the hiring process.</p><br><b>Must Have skills:</b><p>5+ years or more of Manual testing experience<br>2+ years of experience as an SQA in Agile/Scrum/DevOps environment<br>2+ years of experience developing test Automation and the framework from the scratch based on Application requirement using C#, Playwright, Selenium, Robot<br>Experience executing all quality assurance (QA) and testing activities conducted during the project life cycle and ensuring results from these activities are verified thoroughly<br>Experience executing test scripts with any complexity level on multiple projects simultaneously<br>Experience with automated testing and modern DevOps practices<br>Experience with utilizing Agentic AI tools for testing<br>Experience with any legacy to modern application or data conversion<br>Strong experience designing and implementing unit and integration testing strategies<br>Experience overseeing and/or executing test scripts, including setting up the test environment and verifying the test results for success<br>Experience reviewing project requirements and high-level system designs, deriving test strategies and test plans to effectively test the solution, and executing the plan<br>Experience performing metric analysis and develops metric reports for assigned projects; presents project metrics information to management on project defects<br>An aptitude to understand application design models, programming languages, and software testing concepts<br>An aptitude and interest in learning about software development and testing environments<br>Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), as well as an ability to follow standards<br>A high degree of self-motivation, commitment, and integrity<br>Ability to deal with some levels of ambiguity&#8239; <br>Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related analytical field or equivalent experience is preferred<br>Experience using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plan<br>Experience using Microsoft SQL for data validation and manipulation<br>Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related analytical field or equivalent experience is preferred</p><br><b>Nice to have skills:</b><p>Experience with mobile device testing.<br>Experience with API testing.<br>Experience with Agile, Scrum methodologies</p><br><b>Job Function:</b> SQA Analyst<br><br><br></description> 
            <category>C#</category><category>Playwright</category><category>Selenium</category><category>Robot</category><category>Agile</category><category>Scrum</category><category>SQL Server</category><category>Queries</category><category>DevOPS</category>
